svg.text: ENTERPRISE LEGACY CODE MODERNIZATION FACTORY (COBOL / PL-SQL / JAVA 8 -> JAVA 21)
AST Topological Slicing + 10K Golden I/O Replay Tape Reaches 99.8% Equivalence (-86.3% TCO)
500,000 Legacy LOC / 420 Modules: Tier 1 Whole-File LLM (68.5% Parity, $620K) vs. Tier 3 Self-Graded Tests vs. Tier 4 AST + Golden Tape (99.8%, $85K)
⛔ Tier 1 & 3 Traps: COMP-3 Bugs & Self-Graded Tests
1. Whole-File LLM Prompt Translation (31.5% Escaped Logic Bugs):
• Translates COBOL `PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3` into Java `double`,
causing 1-cent rounding errors across millions of bank accounts!
2. Letting the Same LLM Write Code AND Unit Tests (Tier 3: 14.2% Bugs):
• When an LLM misinterprets a legacy DB2/CICS cursor rule, it
writes the exact same wrong assertion into its JUnit test!
3. Unordered Cross-Module Translation (44% Compile Failures):
• Translating callers before leaf COPYBOOKs hallucinations interfaces
Production Failure Impact (500,000 Legacy LOC Migration):
• Escaped Financial / Logic Bugs: 31.5% (Tier 1) | 14.2% (Tier 3)
• Manual IDE Copilot Timeline (Tier 2): 14.5 Months
• Total Migration & Defect Rework TCO: $620,000 per 500K LOC
🏆 Tier 4: AST Leaf-First DAG + 10K Golden I/O Tape Factory
1. ProLeap / Tree-Sitter AST Call-Graph Leaf-First Slicing:
• Topologically sorts COPYBOOKs & PERFORM graphs; migrates leaf
modules first with deterministic `COMP-3 -> BigDecimal` rules
2. 10,000-Vector Recorded Production Golden I/O Replay Harness:
• Replays real legacy batch/CICS inputs against new Java 21 code;
feeds any `$0.01` field discrepancy back into the Repair Agent loop!
3. Strangler-Fig Dark-Traffic Shadowing Before Cutover:
• Mirrors live production traffic to verify 99.8% byte-for-byte parity
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Functional I/O Equivalence: 99.8% (Only 0.2% escaped edge cases)
• 500K LOC Migration Timeline: 2.4 Months (6.0x faster than manual)
• Total Migration TCO: $85,000 (-86.3% savings vs. Tier 1)
